name: Re-engage subscribers
pitch: Send a re-engagement email to subscribers who haven't opened recent newsletters.
instructions: Start by reading the mail log to identify subscribers who have not opened the last three newsletters. When the list is empty, say so and stop. For each subscriber on the list, draft a short, friendly email that asks if they still want to receive the newsletter. When the draft is ready, show it to the person and ask if they want to send it. When they say yes, send the email. When they say no, discard the draft and stop. Never send an email without the person's say-so.

examples.ask: what is the current open rate?
examples.does: read the mail log and tell the person the last open rates

skills.name: identify-inactive-subscribers
skills.description: Find subscribers with no opens in the last three newsletters.
skills.body: 1. Use mail_read to list the last three newsletters sent. 2. For each newsletter, list the recipients and their open status. 3. Compile a list of subscribers who appear in all three but have zero opens. 4. If the list has no names, say 'No inactive subscribers found' and stop.

readme:
# re-engage subscribers
Send a re-engagement email to subscribers who haven't opened recent newsletters.

**What it needs**: mail_read, mail_send
**What it will not do**: send mail without the person's permission
